label: Представление
description: A 10-sentence usage card for представление (notion; show).

missions.fullAnalysis: Strategic focus: Nominative subject. 'Представление' is the nominative subject, here in its 'show' sense. 'Яркое' is the agreeing neuter adjective. A clean descriptive model.
Strategic focus: Accusative direct object. 'Представление' is the accusative object of 'посмотрели'; neuter inanimate nouns match the nominative. 'Интересное' agrees in the neuter accusative.
Strategic focus: Genitive after negation. 'Представления' is the genitive after 'нет', here in its 'notion' sense. 'Ясного' is the agreeing neuter genitive adjective.
Strategic focus: Dative with 'благодаря'. 'Представлению' is the dative governed by 'благодаря', marking the cause of joy. The soft-stem neuter takes the dative ending '-ю'.
Strategic focus: Accusative of direction. 'На представление' uses the accusative after 'на' to express going to an event. 'Вовремя' adds punctuality. A natural attendance pattern.
Strategic focus: Instrumental case. 'Представлением' is the instrumental governed by 'довольны'. The soft-stem neuter takes '-ем'. A natural way to express satisfaction.
Strategic focus: Prepositional case. 'В представлении' uses the prepositional after 'в' to mean 'in one's notion'. 'Моём' is the agreeing neuter prepositional form. An idiomatic mental frame.
Strategic focus: Nominative plural subject. 'Представления' is the nominative plural, the subject of 'идут'. 'Новые' is the agreeing plural adjective. Good for the neuter plural ending '-я'.
Strategic focus: Genitive plural. 'Представлений' is the genitive plural after 'много'; soft-stem neuters end in '-ий'. 'Разных' is the agreeing plural genitive adjective.

missions.phrase: Он имеет смутное представление о работе.
missions.fullAnalysis: Strategic focus: Accusative direct object. 'Представление' is the accusative object of 'имеет', in its 'notion' sense. 'Смутное' agrees in the neuter, and 'о работе' names the topic.
